name: mq_notify
synopsis: int mq_notify(mqd_t mqdes, const struct sigevent *sevp);
description: mq_notify() allows a process to register or unregister for asynchronous notifications when a new message arrives on a specified empty message queue. It uses a sigevent structure to define how notifications are delivered, such as via signals or threads.

parameters.name: mqdes
parameters.description: Message queue descriptor referring to the queue for which notifications are registered or unregistered

parameters.name: sevp
parameters.description: Pointer to a sigevent structure specifying the notification method, or NULL to unregister

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and sets errno to indicate the error

errors.description: The message queue descriptor specified in mqdes is invalid
Another process has already registered to receive notification for this message queue
sevp->sigev_notify is not one of the permitted values; or sevp->sigev_notify is SIGEV_SIGNAL and sevp->sigev_signo is not a valid signal number
